summaries.text: This bill provides eligibility for the Vietnam Service Medal to veterans who participated in Operation End Sweep and submit an application. (Operation End Sweep was a mission to clear mines from Haiphong harbor and surrounding areas after the Vietnam war concluded.)

title: To provide for eligibility for veterans of Operation End Sweep for the Vietnam Service Medal.
